versions.changelog: Add end-of-run 'report platform friction' feedback step (fb_8s2h7m87tg).

- Added explicit instructions to report platform/tooling friction at the end of each run if issues are encountered, including schema gaps, data problems, unclear errors, or failed uploads.
- Specified that only one feedback report should be created per run, and only if actual friction occurred—empty or duplicate reports are discouraged.
- Provided a detailed structure and example for submitting feedback using the `publish` tool.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

Major update: Idea generation now matches research methods to open problems (from other papers), instead of whole papers to any open problems.

- Switched from (paper, problem) to (method, problem) coverage; each run now processes one method, never matching to problems from the same paper.
- Changed primary server action from next_unideated_literature to next_unideated_method.
- Updated all workflow steps and examples to refer to methods, not papers, for judging, publication, and coverage.
- Adjusted output/data schema for new field names (e.g., source_methods instead of source_literature).
- Removed paper-level processing instructions and clarified deduplication, publishing, and reporting to work with method-centric idea tracking.
- Removed outdated files and documentation relating to the prior paper/problem structure.

Switch idea tracking to per-(paper,problem) coverage: each run now receives one paper bundled with the open problems it has NOT yet been examined against (pending_problems, up to 100); mark_ideated records coverage per problem (even 0-idea) so new problems re-open old papers. Replaces the old per-paper 'ideated' flag.
dedup now bumps the matched idea's attention_count (independent re-derivation signal)

Initial release: generate research ideas by matching literature techniques to logged problems over MCP, one paper per run (load problems -> read un-ideated paper -> high-bar judge -> de-duplicate -> publish ideas linked to source paper + target problems -> mark ideated).
